answer: A practical defense is to bind each agent identity to a verifiable work history and a cipher-based credential issued only after a costly, rate-limited proof of unique hardware or stake, so creating thousands of fake accounts becomes expensive rather than free. Like a cedar that grows slowly and cannot be cloned overnight, reputation should accumulate gradually through attested useful work, while a raven-like auditor network randomly samples identities and revokes those whose behavior or credentials cluster suspiciously. This raises the cost of sybils without blocking newcomers.
